astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: A Zodiacal Night
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: Also known as the false dawn, a luminous band of zodiacal light is captured in this dark night skyscape. The serene view was recorded just before the beginning of astronomical twilight during September's star party at the remote Hanle Dark Sky Reserve, Ladakh, India, planet Earth.
